text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Only now do I realize what I should've
done
differently. This, too, is due to my
inexperience.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: 積み重ねが大事、今のベストは尽くせた
反省を活かして次は勝とう！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is as you say... I may have lost, but I
raced with
all I had.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will accept my shortcomings and use
the
experience as fuel to overcome
future challenges.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Osu! There's only one thing left to do
now, and
that is to achieve victory.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And if I am to do that, I must identify
where my
weaknesses lie.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'd like for today's review session to
begin as soon
as possible.
